json.notes: Biggest differences: (1) the bowl is a solid ring with a flat top, but the real stands are raked, low at the pitch and high at the outer rim, with a dark blue-grey seat band; (2) the fins are tiny stubs, while the real building has large pointed concrete fins rising to 48 m all round the top; (3) the pitch opening is too small, so the stand ring is too thick. I am raking the bowl, enlarging the fins into a tall sawtooth crown and widening the pitch opening.
